headline: Antonio Conte: 'No negotiations at advanced stage' amid Man United link
description: Antonio Conte has denied that he is in advanced talks over a new job amid speculation he could replace Michael Carrick at Manchester United.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Como's Paz destroyed Man United -- now they want to sign him
description: Manchester United are monitoring Como attacking midfielder Nico Paz ahead of next season, while Chelsea are also keen. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man United invite fans to fill survey on new stadium
description: Manchester United are inviting fans to provide fresh input on the design of their proposed new 100,000-capacity stadium.

headline: Man United will be 'angry, intense,' Marco Rose warns Bournemouth
description: Marco Rose has told his Bournemouth team to be wary of an angry Manchester United side who will be playing as if they have nothing to lose when they meet at Old Trafford.

headline: João Pedro: I told Cole Palmer 'I didn't want to take his spot' at Chelsea
description: João Pedro has said that a "friendship was born" when he assured Cole Palmer that he wasn't coming to Chelsea to steal his place in the team.

headline: Who will win the Ballon d'Or? Messi, Yamal, Kane -- or someone else?
description: There's no consensus pick for this year's Ballon d'Or -- but maybe there should be. Here's who actually deserves to win it.
